# Bootstrap 5.3.3

`bootstrap.min.css` is the unmodified file from
`https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/bootstrap/5.3.3/css/bootstrap.min.css`
(SRI `sha512-jnSuA4Ss2PkkikSOLtYs8BlYIeeIK1h99ty4YfvRPAlzr377vr3CXDb7sb7eEEBYjDtcYj+AjBH3FLv5uSJuXg==`).
It is served from the site so the first paint does not wait on a connection to
another host. The site uses no Bootstrap JavaScript. MIT licence.
